title: Who the Katos worked with; the Jules brothers and Willie
summary: He worked with all three Katos in different bands, recalls Willie planning a small band after returning from California and then being killed by a car, and notes where a friend now lives.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Ask him who they work with.

Say, who did they work with? Different bands. I used to work with them sometimes. I used to work with all three of them sometimes. Different part of the highs, you know. Mm-hm. I said, I said, man, he comes over after a while. He's dead, too. How about them Jules of Brothers? One of them, two of them, you know, Willie got kicked, you know. Me and Willie was an organizer band when he come back from California. He left his wife over there to tend to some business, you know, and he sold the property. And I told him, I said, Willie, he come and see me. He said, what you doing? I said, man, he's dead down here. He said, why don't you get up a little four or five piece band? He said, you think we can make it? I said, that's what I like to do. I said, I think we can make it. So we talked over. I said, all right, Willie, you come here tomorrow and we fix everything up. I said, bring your horns with you. He told me, all right. Willie, it's real. You know, it don't rain all day. But Willie didn't show up. If he had to come to my house, he'd been living today.
